tasks.short: Log call outcomes, promises to pay, disputes and customer credit facts in Excel tracker and AFAS notes.

steps.what: Write call and mail outcome into Excel collections tracker

loop.input: Officer's short call notes or debtor mail thread
loop.output: Structured record: outcome code, promised amount, promised date, dispute reason
loop.check: Amount and invoice numbers must match open items in AFAS; date must be in the future; officer confirms on screen
loop.stop: One pass per note; if fields fail the check the form stays blank for manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: Notes and mails are free text; a plain form works but costs typing time on every call

steps.what: Copy promises and dispute status into AFAS debtor notes
Update customer facts: KvK changes, insurer limit, payment behaviour
Compile weekly collections status for Controller and sales

tasks.design: Replace the Excel collections tracker with a small case app on the governed data platform that reads AFAS open items through the API and writes notes back to AFAS debtor records. A bounded model step turns call notes into structured outcomes the officer confirms; a nightly job checks KvK changes and insurer limits; the Power BI finance model gets a collections page instead of the weekly mail.
tasks.previous_blocker: The tracker sits between AFAS and Outlook and nobody owned an integration; free-text notes could not be structured cheaply.
tasks.enabler_now: AFAS has a REST connector, AI-assisted coding makes a small case app a matter of days, and models extract amount and date from short notes reliably enough to confirm in one click.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping one source of truth when sales and operations also talk to the same shipper; insurer portals may lack an API.
tasks.human_edge: Judging whether a promise is credible and what a customer's tone means for the next step.

ambition.what: Weekly credit-limit review per top-50 shipper instead of a yearly check

tasks.altitude: The officer stops typing logs and spends the saved two hours a week reviewing broken promises and limit changes, with the right to propose limit changes to the Controller.

reach.task: Posting receipts and credit notes in AFAS
reach.learn: Which notes they need to match payments to promises
How promises to pay can feed the weekly cash forecast

evidence.claim: 30% of Dutch finance professionals name manual Excel, mail and export work as the biggest cash-flow problem
AFAS Profit exposes debtor data through REST connectors
Credit scoring of natural persons is high-risk under the AI Act; sole-trader hauliers fall in scope

assumptions: The tracker today is an Excel file on SharePoint
unknowns: Which credit insurer is used and whether it has an API
Whether AFAS debtor notes are used by bookkeepers today
How many active debtors are sole traders
research_questions: How many minutes per day go to logging, measured over one week?
Can AFAS debtor notes be written through the API with the current licence?
Do officers accept confirming a pre-filled note rather than typing?

tasks.short: Export AFAS open items, build ageing and priority list in Excel, check payments, pick whom to chase.

steps.what: Export open debtor items from AFAS to Excel
Build ageing buckets and priority list in Excel
Check bank statements and disputes so paid items are not chased
Decide whom to chase today and in what order

tasks.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls AFAS open items and the latest bank match status each morning, applies ageing and priority rules (amount, days overdue, broken promise, insurer limit) and fills a daily work queue in the collections case app plus a Power BI ageing page. AFAS auto-matching is tuned first so paid items drop out before the list is built.
tasks.previous_blocker: The ageing logic lived in one person's Excel; AFAS reports were not trusted because bank matching lagged.
tasks.enabler_now: AFAS bank-statement auto-match rules can be configured, and AI coding makes a rule-based priority job cheap to build and change.
tasks.still_hard: Unmatched receipts still need a bookkeeper; priority rules need tuning with the officer's judgement for the first months.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which shipper pays late but always pays, and which silence means trouble.

ambition.what: Daily re-prioritised chase list instead of a weekly Excel refresh

tasks.altitude: The officer starts the day with a ready queue and owns the priority rules with the Controller, adjusting weights monthly.

reach.learn: Which match rules leave the most unmatched receipts
How the ageing feed supports the bad-debt provision

evidence.claim: AFAS matches bank lines on payment reference, IBAN, invoice number and oldest-first sums; misses go to a person
81% of Dutch finance professionals explain DSO after the fact

assumptions: Bank statements reach AFAS daily from Rabobank
Power BI AFAS extract can be extended with debtor tables
unknowns: Current share of receipts matched automatically in AFAS
Number of open debtor items per month
research_questions: What share of the chase list today turns out already paid?
Would a daily refresh change who is called first, tested on four past weeks?
Is the nightly Power BI extract fresh enough or is an intraday pull needed?

tasks.short: Send reminders and final notices by mail, phone debtors who stay late to get payment.

steps.what: Select invoices due for first or second reminder
Write and send standard reminder mails in Outlook
Prepare final notice with statutory interest and EUR 40 compensation
Gather history, delivery proof and disputes before a call

loop.input: Open items, last notes, recent mail thread with the debtor
loop.output: Half-page call brief: amounts, past promises, open disputes, suggested ask
loop.check: Amounts and invoice numbers are filled by code from AFAS, the model only writes the summary text; officer reads before calling
loop.stop: One draft per call; on failure show the raw history
loop.why_not_simpler: Mail threads are free text; the amounts part is deterministic already

steps.what: Phone the debtor and agree payment or next step

tasks.design: Configure AFAS dunning with Noordhaven's reminder sequence and Dutch/English templates so standard reminders go out without touch; a deterministic generator on the data platform drafts final notices with BW 6:119a interest and the EUR 40 minimum, which the officer approves. Before each call the case app shows a brief built from AFAS data plus a bounded model summary of the mail thread.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reminders were tailored by hand because templates and contract terms varied per shipper, and interest calculations were done in Excel.
tasks.enabler_now: AFAS dunning is standard functionality; statutory interest is pure rules; models summarise mail threads well enough for a brief a person reads.
tasks.still_hard: Customer-specific payment terms must be clean in AFAS first; calls stay human and take most of the time.
tasks.human_edge: Persuading a shipper on the phone, reading their situation and keeping the commercial relationship intact.

ambition.what: Small shippers under EUR 5k get a timely reminder sequence for the first time instead of being skipped

tasks.altitude: The officer's week shifts from writing letters to calls with the 30-40 accounts that matter, with the right to approve every final notice.

reach.learn: How claimed interest and EUR 40 charges are posted and reversed

reach.task: Setting payment terms in customer contracts
reach.learn: Which non-standard terms break the dunning sequence

evidence.claim: B2B statutory commercial interest runs from the due date or 30 days after invoice; at least EUR 40 compensation is due without a reminder
Errors in the first letter, interest or costs surface only later in court
Wki registration covers parties chasing on another's behalf; chasing own invoices is not described as covered
Standard reminders with model-assisted wording run at high autonomy

assumptions: Noordhaven sends its own reminders, not through an agency
Debtors are reachable by mail addresses held in AFAS
unknowns: Whether Noordhaven's general terms set their own interest or cost clauses
Share of debtors that are sole traders or partnerships
Whether AFAS dunning module is licensed
research_questions: How many reminders a month are sent today and how many are hand-edited?
Do customer contracts deviate from standard payment terms, and how often?
Does an automatic first reminder lower days overdue in a four-week pilot on small shippers?

tasks.short: Answer shipper mails and calls about invoices, statements, delivery proof and disputed charges.

steps.what: Read and sort incoming mails in the debtors mailbox

loop.output: Request type (invoice copy, statement, POD, dispute, payment notice, other) and invoice numbers
loop.check: Invoice numbers must exist in AFAS for that debtor; low confidence goes to the officer's queue
loop.stop: One pass per mail; unknown or mixed requests go to the human queue
loop.why_not_simpler: Mail rules on keywords miss Dutch/English free text and remittance mails without structure

steps.what: Look up invoice, statement and proof of delivery
Reply with documents or an explanation

loop.input: Classified request, account data and attached documents
loop.output: Reply draft in the customer's language
loop.check: Standard document requests use fixed templates and send automatically; any explanation text is a draft the officer approves
loop.stop: One draft; if documents are missing, route to the officer
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations of charges and surcharges need free wording; document requests alone do not

steps.what: Handle disputes: ask sales or operations, request credit note

tasks.design: Put a bounded classifier on the shared debtors mailbox that tags requests and invoice numbers, after which deterministic code pulls statements and invoice copies from AFAS and proof of delivery from SharePoint and sends standard replies from templates. Explanations get a model draft for approval, and disputes open a case in the collections app that routes to sales or operations and to a bookkeeper for credit notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests arrive as free text in mixed Dutch and English, and documents sit in three places, so rules alone could not sort them.
tasks.enabler_now: Models classify short business mails reliably within a checkable output, and AFAS plus SharePoint can be read by API.
tasks.still_hard: Proof of delivery may sit in a transport system outside the listed ones; disputes over damage and surcharges need operations input.
tasks.human_edge: Resolving a disputed charge fairly while keeping the shipper as a customer.

ambition.what: Self-service statement and invoice copy link for shippers, sent automatically on request

tasks.altitude: Routine document requests disappear from the officer's day; they gain the right to log dispute causes and report them monthly to sales and operations.

reach.learn: Which dispute types end in credit notes and why
How dispute causes such as surcharges erode customer margin

evidence.claim: Account questions suit an agent with a gate that sends statements, invoice copies and proof of delivery
Genpact's AR suite promises up to 30% faster disputes, as indicative estimates only

assumptions: A shared debtors mailbox exists in Outlook
Proof of delivery is stored as files reachable from SharePoint
unknowns: Where proof of delivery documents actually live
Volume of debtor mails per week and share that are simple document requests
research_questions: What share of a month's debtor mails are pure document requests?
Can proof of delivery be found by invoice or order number without a person?
How accurate is classification on 200 past mails, Dutch and English mixed?

role.altitude: From typing logs, building Excel lists and writing reminders to running the order-to-cash rules: priority weights, reminder sequences, final-notice approval, credit-limit proposals and monthly dispute-cause feedback to sales and operations.
reach: Bookkeeper: bank matching and credit notes in AFAS
Controller: debtor provisioning and payment terms in contracts
FP&A Analyst: cash-in forecast fed by promises to pay
skills_to_grow: Writing and tuning collection priority rules
Reading Power BI ageing and DSO dashboards
Root-cause analysis of disputes with operations
role.ambitious_version: The officer runs a daily, rule-driven collections desk where reminders and document requests need no touch, every call starts from a brief, and dispute causes are reported monthly so DSO and the share of disputed invoices fall, feeding a weekly cash-in forecast the Finance Director trusts.
